abstract: A case is presented of choriocarcinoma with cerebral metastases which was unsuspected until a life-threatening life-threatening situation occurred. A viable infant was born and there was dramatic response to treatment with probable cure.
abstract_ja: 初回妊娠中に、生命を脅かす状況が生じるまで予期されなかった脳転移を伴う絨毛癌の症例を提示する。生児が出生し、治療に劇的な反応が得られ、治癒が見込まれた。
